description: Down needs two misses. The board's direct-check read (Snipers and CAM Vs) also reads confirmed_outage and consecutive_failures, and a unit whose saved check has missed exactly once reads Not verified, with 'Avigilon check missed once, checking again' on the card, instead of Down. Two misses in a row, or a confirmed outage, is Down as before. A row with no count is never treated as a first miss, so an outage is not hidden when the count was not read. Three exact edits to live v21; nothing else changes. Nothing is written to any database.
authorization: James, 2026-11-25, after eight field Snipers read Down on one bad sweep and were back fifteen minutes later: 'Proceed with your recomendations' (a unit should need two consecutive misses before it reads Down). Running the deploy still needs his explicit go for that run.

edits.needle: down: status2 === "online" ? [] : [{ name: ip ? "Avigilon check" : "No IP on file", status: status2 }],
edits.replacement: down: status2 === "online" ? [] : [{ name: !ip ? "No IP on file" : missedOnce ? "Avigilon check missed once, checking again" : "Avigilon check", status: status2 }],
